name: get_email_thread
description: Fetch a full email conversation thread by Gmail thread id (or seed message id). Returns messages in chronological order.

inputs.name: thread_id
inputs.description: Gmail thread id for the conversation.

inputs.name: seed_message_id
inputs.description: A Gmail message id inside the target thread. Used to resolve thread id when thread_id is omitted.

inputs.name: participant_email
inputs.description: Email address to resolve a recent conversation thread when thread_id and seed_message_id are not provided.

inputs.name: account_id
inputs.description: Optional Google OAuth account id for per-call mailbox selection (default "google_user_primary").

inputs.name: include_body
inputs.description: Whether to include parsed message body text.

inputs.name: include_recent_messages
inputs.description: When participant_email is provided, also return recent participant messages across threads (default true).

inputs.name: recent_message_limit
inputs.description: Maximum recent participant messages to include (default 8, max 50).

inputs.name: lookback_hours
inputs.description: Optional lookback window in hours for participant search (for example 10).

outputs.description: Recent participant messages (cross-thread context), if enabled.

metadata.planner_description: Fetch a full conversation thread by id, seed message, or participant.
